description: Extend the factory graph editor Add worker flow with a model-vs-script worker toggle so operators can create SCRIPT_WORKER entries with command and args or MODEL_WORKER entries with model provider and model, and persist the chosen type through graph save into factory.json.

context.customerAsk: Add-worker flow toggles between model worker and script worker; script worker captures command and args; model worker captures model provider and model; persisted factory.json reflects chosen worker type.
context.problem: The graph editor Add worker dialog and additions layer only support MODEL_WORKER with modelProvider/model fields. Script workers are supported elsewhere in the product but cannot be created from the add-worker flow, forcing manual factory.json edits.
context.solution: Extend the worker add draft, validation, and apply logic for both worker types; conditionally render fields in the add dialog; reuse worker-detail messages and parseWorkerArgsText conventions; prove save-round-trip with focused unit and integration tests.

acceptanceCriteria: Add worker dialog includes a model vs script worker type control (default model)
Model path requires model provider and optional model; applied addition has type MODEL_WORKER with captured fields
Script path requires command and optional newline-separated args; applied addition has type SCRIPT_WORKER with command and args array when provided
Switching type in the dialog hides and clears the other type's fields so additions do not mix model and script data
Graph save persists the new worker into factory.json with the selected type and type-specific fields
Automated tests cover additions validate/apply, add-dialog interaction, and save-input projection for script workers
UI typecheck, lint, and affected tests pass

validateFactoryGraphAddEntityDraft requires modelProvider only for MODEL_WORKER and non-empty command for SCRIPT_WORKER; rejects argsText containing null bytes
applyFactoryGraphAddEntityDraft appends MODEL_WORKER with modelProvider and optional model, or SCRIPT_WORKER with command and optional args parsed via parseWorkerArgsText
factory-graph-editor-additions.test.ts covers model-only, model with model id, script command-only, and script command plus args apply results
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
